services.name: Comedy Shows Austin
services.desc: Every comedy show happening in Austin this week. Stand-up, improv, open mics, and touring acts across every venue in town. Updated regularly so you always know what's on tonight. Austin runs comedy shows every single night of the week. That wasn't true five years ago. Today you have a dozen venues competing for your attention, which means more shows, better lineups, and cheaper tickets than almost any other comedy city in the country. Here's how to find the right show for any given night. Shows run every night at 8pm, with additional late shows on weekends at 10pm. The room is small enough that every seat feels like front row. services.name: Comedy Date Night in Austin
services.desc: Forget the dinner-and-movie script. An 82-seat comedy club with dim lights, velvet curtains, and BYOB for $10 a ticket is the date night Austin doesn't know about yet. Here's the thing about dinner dates: you sit across from someone and try to be interesting for two hours. That's a lot of pressure. Comedy flips the dynamic. You sit next to someone, facing the same direction, laughing at the same things. The comedian does the heavy lifting. You just have to show up and react. Laughing together does something that conversation alone can't. It breaks tension. It reveals taste. You learn a lot about someone by what makes them laugh. services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Book Austin's most intimate comedy club for your next corporate event, team outing, birthday, or private show. 82 seats, BYOB, food truck on-site, and a custom comedy lineup built for your group. Most corporate events follow the same formula: open bar, small talk, someone gives a speech nobody listens to. A private comedy show is the opposite. Everyone's in the same room, laughing at the same thing, actually having a shared experience. It's the fastest way to get a group of people who barely know each other to relax and connect.
